title: PMINT (B-Roll)
description: U.S. Marines with the 22nd Marine Expeditionary Unit (MEU), and Sailors with the Amphibious Squadron 6 (PHIBRON), train aboard the USS Arlington (LPD-24) during PHIBRON-MEU Integration Training, Atlantic Ocean N.C., June 18, 2018. PHIBRON-MEU Integration Training is a two-week training evolution that allows Marines and Sailors to train as a cohesive unit in preparation to their upcoming deployment. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Staff Sgt. Andrew Ochoa)
